Post-EQ rejection logs now distinguish cancellation, absent evidence and target underfill without changing limits; the workflow crate check passes.

Detectability cannot stand in for equivalence; a separate numeric preregistered ABX equivalence rule passes 17/30 against a 0.75 bound using exact lower-tail scoring, with independent coefficient agreement and matching numeric comparison/rule bounds and a declared alternative that attains target power. Imported protocols rerun registration validation, rejecting self-consistently rehashed invalid rules, underpowered designs, duplicate conditions, and design mismatches before scoring. Real imports require a balanced seed-derived answer key and raw responses; claim qualification additionally requires a frozen setup hash over binding, population, absolute level, matching method, programme classes and holdouts. The setup freezes pseudonymous participant IDs and a trial-to-participant allocation; real rows must match, and a participant cannot repeat within a condition. The three-presentation battery now binds cells to frozen setup conditions, level calibration, material class and protocol sizing, then recomputes battery verdicts from exactly one raw import per frozen setup and records content hashes for those validated imports. The scorer rejects incomplete, repeated, renamed and impossible validated condition cells. Incomplete real imports disclose every affected condition and the missing preregistered trial IDs; synthetic outcomes never promote. Software-path evidence only.
